name: Shiori
message: "Looks like she really isn't here..."

name: Shiori
message: "It's strange, even to me... to be this caught up over a girl I only ever caught a glimpse of..."

name: Shiori
message: "Sorry for dragging you into all this. And thank you. You're a huge help."

name: Shiori
message: "Since we're already here, why don't we sit down and take a break?"

name: Shiori
message: "You must be tired from all this walking. Let's rest for a bit."
(Sit down)

name: Shiori
message: "Come to think of it... why was I hanging myself here when we first met?"

name: Shiori
message: "I do have faint memories of hanging myself in various places, thinking that maybe my next death would be the last."

name: Shiori
message: "But like I said, it's all faint."

name: Shiori
message: "I don't have any clear memories of what I was doing before I met you."

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe... I was already fading."

name: Shiori
message: "In the first place, I'm not even sure if killing myself over and over would really make me pass on."

name: Shiori
message: "My ego was wearing thin; I wasn't really thinking anymore. I had no energy left to reflect. I just kept killing myself over and over, acting on whatever impulse came to mind..."

name: Shiori
message: "But after meeting you, I finally got to talk to someone again for the first time in so long. You might have just stopped my collapse at the very last moment."

name: Shiori
message: "When I think about it that way, you're my savior. Because as long as you're here with me, I can still stay... me."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you, really."

name: Shiori
message: "Ehehe, I know that probably came out of nowhere, but I just wanted to say it. You've helped me so much."

name: Shiori
message: "Now then, I'd say it's about time for us to get going."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, right. I'm so glad Gyaruko-san got her memories back."

name: Shiori
message: "I think her name was the key that opened the door to her memories."

name: Shiori
message: "As for me, I only remember my name, and everything else is gone... I guess it really does vary from person to person."

name: Shiori
message: "I should have something that works as a key too. Maybe it's the man she told me about..."

name: Shiori
message: "Wait, hold on. If the key to my memories is a man who might be the culprit... doesn't that basically mean I'm almost certainly involved in the case?"

name: Shiori
message: "Which would mean... maybe it's better if I *don't* remember...?"

name: Shiori
message: "Well, there *is* no doubt I've been strangely fixated on this case... so in the end, I guess we just have to meet him."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay then, shall we get going?"

name: Shiori
message: "Hey, about Uribayashi Rina-san..."

name: Shiori
message: "Even if she really was Girl A... I still don't think she has anything to do with the case itself."

name: Shiori
message: "I mean, she was looking for her child who passed away, right? It doesn't make sense for her to help with a murder."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, but... I guess it's also possible that someone took advantage of her grief..."

name: Shiori
message: "I shouldn't let my imagination run wild just because of that lady's sketchy story... I need to rein myself in."

name: Shiori
message: "Where does she even get those stories? There are probably others like her too. People who just love to gossip."

name: Shiori
message: "They probably have their own little community, spreading rumors about all kinds of people, regardless of whether they're true or not..."

name: Shiori
message: "What if I was the type who enjoyed gossip too? I'd probably die of self-loathing the moment I get my memories back..."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm already dead, though."

name: Shiori
message: "You know, your quietness is part of your charm, but at times like this, you should try laughing a little. It can really help someone."

name: Shiori
message: "Anyway, let's get going before I say something awkward again."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, right. I just remembered something."

name: Shiori
message: "I think my half-baked occult knowledge was because of my sister."

name: Shiori
message: "You see, my little sister was kind of odd."

name: Shiori
message: "Most five-year-olds would cry when watching horror movies, right? They're scary, after all."

name: Shiori
message: "But she'd always squeal with excitement. She'd get so fired up whenever a character died in some gruesome way."

name: Shiori
message: "We watched all sorts of horror films together."

name: Shiori
message: "She liked manga too. She was smart enough to read difficult kanji without any trouble."

name: Shiori
message: "Dad didn't mind as long as she learned something from it, regardless of the content... but Mom was worried."

name: Shiori
message: "Mom would worry about my sister's future, since she derived joy from seeing corpses. Ehehe, of course she'd worry. She never looked too pleased about it."

name: Shiori
message: "If she's still alive... How old would she be? What kind of woman did she grow into?"

name: Shiori
message: "I don't know where my family moved to, though. It's a shame I can't see her."

name: Shiori
message: "Not that it would matter if I did... I can't even remember her face, so I wouldn't be able to recognize her anyway."

name: Shiori
message: "Sorry, that got a little heavy. Let's go."

name: Shiori
message: "I know this is reaaally trivial, but... ghosts actually have something close to the five senses."

name: Shiori
message: "Strange, isn't it? I don't even have a body anymore, but when I'm here, or when I was walking through the flower garden, I'd catch the faint scent of the flowers."

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe my soul remembers. Maybe it's unconsciously replaying the sensations I had when I was alive."

name: Shiori
message: "I still can't eat food, though. I think I mentioned that before. Even if I swallow it, it just comes back up."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... I just realized. Gagging and puking are bodily reactions, right? So how can a ghost gag without a body? Is that another memory of the soul?"

name: Shiori
message: "I wonder if someday, even mysteries like this will end up getting explained by science."

name: Shiori
message: "This conversation is starting to wander. Let's get going."

name: Shiori
message: "It suddenly occurred to me, but... did I not have any friends?"

name: Shiori
message: "No, I mean, I can vaguely picture myself chatting with friends at school. So I must have had some."

name: Shiori
message: "But still, if I had close friends, wouldn't I be trying to look for them right now? Like, someone who would definitely know me? Yet I haven't done that at all, not even once."

name: Shiori
message: "So maybe I did have friends, but... none close enough for me to seek out?"

name: Shiori
message: "...Wait, hold on. Didn't I... commute by train? Maybe my friends just didn't live around here..."

name: Shiori
message: "But then what about my elementary and middle school friends? Did those relationships fade away too...?"

name: Shiori
message: "This is starting to get a little depressing... Let's go."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, now that we've refreshed ourselves, shall we get going?"
